description: Physical constants of the secular J2 model, spec II.10 constants table. This file is the only place these values live: no Python module under backend/api/ may repeat them (spec II.10, and the test test_no_physical_constant_is_hard_coded_in_service_source).

sources.J2: EGM2008 second zonal harmonic, value as recorded in SCIENCE Sec A.2; spec II.10 constants table
sources.GM: Earth gravitational parameter, NASA GSFC GDC Orbit Primer October 2018 (formula set VERIFIED, SCIENCE Sec F.7), value SCIENCE Sec A.2; spec II.10 constants table
sources.R_e: Earth equatorial radius, EGM2008 and WGS84, SCIENCE Sec A.2; spec II.10 constants table
sources.omega_sid_rad_s: Earth sidereal rotation rate, SCIENCE Sec A.4; spec II.10 constants table
sources.gmst_model: IAU 1982 sidereal time with nutation omitted, model choice and precision note SCIENCE Sec G.11; spec IV constants_block

provenance.J2: hard-coded universal constant, printed with its source on every result
provenance.GM: hard-coded universal constant, printed with its source on every result
provenance.R_e: hard-coded universal constant, printed with its source on every result
provenance.omega_sid_rad_s: hard-coded universal constant, printed with its source on every result
provenance.gmst_model: hard-coded algorithm choice, recorded rather than derived
